coverage.why: The gate dropped the accounting area controls_audit_and_filing_signals ('a number written in the analyst's own words'). The other accounting areas, the industry lens and every financial section were answered.

calibration.why: Each surviving area verdict tracks its anomalies: estimates_and_reserves 'concern' over the reserve items, cost_deferral 'low concern on capitalisation' with restructuring flagged, industry_lens 'elevated risk' over inventory and commitments. The controls area has no verdict to compare because of the gate drop.
